# ARC-02-C Review — attempt 1 (the only authorized attempt)

**Provenance:** externally generated by the founder via ChatGPT image tool (founder-supplied, no tool/seed details given). Received as a **full 2000x1155 frame**, not an edited 2000x1160 hall crop: the model regenerated the whole scene instead of masked-editing the hall. File kept as `ARC-02-C-attempt1-fullframe.webp`. **Not composited** (the composite step assumes a crop edit; compositing a regenerated full frame would misrepresent it). Founder approval: **NO**.

## Gates
| # | Gate | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Exactly six fermenters, counted twice | **FAIL — seven.** Left: 3 (two large + one small west of deck). Right: large nearest + **three** behind it (sleeves at four distinct positions right of the deck). Counted twice at 4x. |
| 2 | Exactly two copper vessels | PASS — two, under a copper hood and stack |
| 3 | Oblique D arrangement readable | PARTIAL — deck centre, left group and large right tank present; right-hand group has an extra tank |
| 4 | Graphite cones | **FAIL** — cones are light brushed-silver/tan, not dark graphite |
| 5 | Six narrow deep-marigold sleeves | **FAIL** — seven, thicker than ~6 in, saturated and glowing (sampled ≈ (241,105,5), (250,130,2): hotter/yellower than #E8870E) |
| 6 | Hall lighting matches ARC-02-A night exposure | **FAIL** — hall is flooded orange; reads as an orange wash |
| 7 | No daytime sky/foliage behind the glass | **FAIL** — sunset-coloured sky and tree reflections remain in the left and upper panes |
| 8 | No obvious composite boundaries | N/A (full-frame regeneration); no seams but also no lock |
| 9 | Original mullions aligned | **FAIL** — mullion positions/spacing differ from ARC-02-A (regenerated) |
| 10 | Outside-hall drift ≈ 0 | **FAIL** — whole frame regenerated; 2000x1155 vs A's 2000x1114; mean abs diff vs A (resized) ≈ 35/255 outside the hall |
| 11 | Hall the brightest large feature without clipping | **FAIL** — brightest, but orange-clipped sleeves/copper and lamp starbursts |
| 12 | Rubric >= 90 | **FAIL** — 71/100 |
| 13 | No hard fail | **FAIL** |

## Additional defects
Pendant spot lights read as string lights on the hall ceiling; a lamp star-flare near the upper-left; heavy glow/bloom on glass; people count and court detail changed from ARC-02-A. Positives: copper hood/stack and deck with stair/guardrails are convincing; stainless highlights are good; exterior is attractive.

## Score (strict)
Continuity 12/20, Tank Cloister 11/20, originality 11/15, Austin plausibility 8/10, materials 5/10, hospitality 9/10, photorealism 7/10, cultural restraint 4/5 = **67/100**.
**Hard fails:** seven fermenters; silver cones; thick glowing sleeves; day/sunset reflections in glass; orange wash; outside-hall not preserved; mullions not locked; string-light/starburst effects.

## Decision
**ARC-02-C FAILED — STOP.** No ARC-02-D, no further generation, no retouching until a new founder decision. ARC-02-A stays the best night-exterior reference but is not canonical. The attempt did not use the mask: the tool ignored it (full-frame output), which is itself the main process failure.
